explanation: OEIS A300997 (number of steps for the 1D 'give half your mass, rounded down, to the right neighbour' cellular automaton started from one cell of mass n to reach n cells of mass 1): 'it appears that the finite difference of this sequence only contains 1's and 2's'. The formal ca_step keeps ⌈m/2⌉, passes ⌊m/2⌋ to the right and trims trailing zeros, and a(n) is the first time the configuration equals n ones. The statement a(n+1) − a(n) ∈ {1, 2} for n ≥ 1 matches. Faithful.
